notes: Draft configuration: Reviewed the organizer’s 2024 historic-course plan: Rempart Desaix and Avenue des Maréchaux lead through the Théâtre/Carnot turn, Rue Louis Desbrandes, Rue Waldeck Rousseau, the full Marronnier return on Rue du Colonel Driant, Rue de Verdun and the Cathédrale turn. Retains the pinned unnamed street connection at the southern Carnot turn and the short Avenue du Président Wilson connection at the cathedral; excludes the internal Driant shortcut and the unrelated Rempart du Midi. All vertices and joins use exact independent road-map nodes. The 1303.4 m public-road centerline differs from the 1271 m timing distance; temporary race barriers, hairpin placement and the mapped underpass junction remain provisional. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 1303.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 36 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
